tasks.title: Deploy Wan 2.2 Templates UI on Netlify
tasks.subtitle: PR #1 merged · still need Netlify site + phone Generate test
steps: Repo PR #1 (gallery + how-to) is already merged on GitHub — skip waiting on code
Open Netlify → Add new site → Import an existing project
Choose GitHub → authorize if asked → pick Simzy420/wan22-templates
Build command: npm run build
Publish directory: dist
Add env var VITE_HF_SPACE = https://simzy-wan-2-2-templates.hf.space
Deploy site, open the Netlify URL on your phone
Scroll demo templates → pick one → upload a still of yourself → Generate
If Generate fails with CORS: in repo public/config.js set USE_PROXY true, redeploy, and add Netlify env HF_TOKEN (your Hugging Face token)
Reply here or in Command Center with the Netlify URL when it is live
